name: Carbon Forge
description: Carbon Forge is source control and a shared record for people and AI agents. Code, files and prose live in one record on the server, read and written through the same tools over MCP. An agent opens a lane, a set of patches over the trunk, instead of cloning; each landing is one all-or-nothing changeset; blame, grep and history run on the server; git is a projection pushed to GitHub. Public workspaces read over MCP without a token. We build Carbon Forge at 100monkeys.ai.
